blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around East Central

items.t: Municipality: City of Maple Ridge, BC.

Boundaries: the City publishes no boundary for the MLS "East Central" sub-area: UNVERIFIED as an official boundary. The Town Centre Area Plan covers the downtown core at the west side of the sub-area (boundaries expanded in the plan update to incorporate River Bend).
Nearby areas: West Central and the Town Centre to the west, Cottonwood to the east, Southwest Maple Ridge (Port Haney) at the southwest corner, and Albion further east along Lougheed Highway.

Main roads: Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) along the south side; Dewdney Trunk Road east–west through downtown and the residential area to the east; 224 Street and 226 Street north–south through the downtown core; the Haney Bypass links Lougheed Highway to Port Haney at the southwest corner. Commute times in minutes: UNVERIFIED.

Transit anchors: Haney Place Exchange is in this sub-area (routes include the R3, 701, 733, 741, 743, 744, 745, 746, 748, 749 and 791); the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus runs from Coquitlam Central Station to Haney Place; Port Haney Station, 22300 River Road, at the southwest corner, runs weekday West Coast Express trains between Waterfront and Mission City.

Schools physically inside the sub-area (Ministry-listed names only): Golden Ears Elementary (K–7), 23124 118 Avenue; Harry Hooge Elementary (K–7), 12280 230 Street; Thomas Haney Secondary (7–12), 23000 116 Avenue; ci:tməxw Environmental Community (K–8), 23125 116 Avenue; District 42 Alternative Secondary (9–12), 23125 116 Avenue. SD42 has no middle tier: elementary is K–7 and secondary is 8–12, with Thomas Haney listed at 7–12 on the provincial list. Catchments are address-based — for the downtown sample address 11897 227 Street the locator gives Eric Langton Elementary and Thomas Haney Secondary, with French Immersion options at Maple Ridge Elementary (early), Eric Langton Elementary (late) and Maple Ridge Secondary; that result is single-address only and does not transfer to any other East Central address.

Civic anchors: Maple Ridge Leisure Centre, 11925 Haney Place; Memorial Peace Park on 224 Street between Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road (City Hall, the Greg Moore Youth Centre, The ACT Arts Centre and Haney Place Mall around it; Cenotaph, Bandstand, Haney Farmers Market); Maple Ridge Public Library (Fraser Valley Regional Library), 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road, the only FVRL branch in Maple Ridge; Ridge Meadows Urgent and Primary Care Centre inside Haney Place Mall, 121 – 11900 Haney Place, open 7 days a week, 9:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.; Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, west of this sub-area, with 24/7 emergency care.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in East Central

items.t: Lougheed Transit Corridor — ADOPTED Jan 27, 2026 (City record): Official Community Plan Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021 was given third reading and adopted Jan 27, 2026 (City news release Feb 4, 2026); the corridor runs from the City's western boundary to the Town Centre at 221 Street along Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road — cited here as adopted.
Albion Area Plan: adopted Oct 28, 2025 — east of this sub-area, part of the same fall 2025 update series as the Town Centre changes.

Floodplain (south edge): along River Road / Port Haney the flood construction level is 6.7 m geodetic (including freeboard), a covenant on title identifies construction in the floodplain, no habitable floor space may be located below the flood construction level on affected lots, and Zoning Bylaw s. 402.8(h) prohibits rental accommodation (suites) on floodplain properties.

Escarpment: the Fraser River Escarpment policy area reaches the sub-area's west edge (its east boundary is 224 Street); lots within 300 m of the escarpment crest require a geotechnical report attached to a Section 219 covenant before a building permit.

BC strata block — applies in full to any bare-land strata lot here: Form B (SPA s. 59), provided within 7 days, max $35 plus up to 25¢/page; depreciation reports every five years for stratas with five or more lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2 + Reg 7.01, May 1, 2023 exemptions); a "45+" listing line is NOT a valid age bylaw.

ALR block — stated for completeness, governing no identified East Central ground: subdivision within the ALR requires Agricultural Land Commission approval, and ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Information Bulletin 09, s. 6; Strata Property Act, s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act, s. 21(1)). Residence caps: one principal residence per parcel, maximum 500 m²; a secondary suite only inside the principal residence; one additional residence capped at 90 m² on parcels of 40 ha or less and 186 m² on parcels over 40 ha. Farm class (BC Assessment) in full three-tier form: $2,500 of gross farm income at 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 plus 5% of the actual value of the area over 4 ha above that; $10,000 under 0.8 ha — applications by October 31. A flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR and none is asserted here.

Planned transit — price on today's service: TransLink's Langley–Haney Place BRT is in detailed planning — 22 km between Willowbrook and Haney Place with peak service every 10 minutes; designs, costs and timelines are not yet determined.

items.t: The page's own scope and its feed disagree.
The City names "Brickwater" but does not type it.

Density policy is the land story here, not vacant lots. The Town Centre Core designation, the two Transit-Oriented Areas (Bylaw No. 8001-2024), the adopted Lougheed Transit Corridor (Bylaw No. 7781-2021, adopted Jan 27, 2026, ending at 221 St) and the Albion Area Plan adoption (Oct 28, 2025) all push value into assemblies and added units on built lots — pricing a teardown on today's single-house use alone misses the documented direction, and pricing it as if rezoning were assured overpays for a designation, not an approval.

Fee-simple lots

items.t: RS-1 house lots (residential streets east and north of downtown): single-detached housing on fee-simple lots under RS-1 (Single Detached Residential), Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 s. 605 — minimum lot area 668.0 m², minimum lot width 18.0 m, minimum lot depth 27.0 m, maximum lot coverage 40%. These are the zone's subdivision minimums, not a claim that every existing lot meets them — older lots predate the current bylaw and vary lot by lot, UNCONFIRMED here.

Town Centre parcels: Town Centre commercial, multi-family and comprehensive development zones under the same Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 govern the downtown core parcels; minimum lot sizes for those multi-family and comprehensive development zones are UNVERIFIED in the research and are not filled in here.
Servicing: the research documents no parcel-level servicing statement for East Central (municipal water/sewer vs well/septic).

ALR vs non-ALR: no Agricultural Land Reserve land in East Central was identified in the official sources checked; parcel-level ALR status can be checked on the Agricultural Land Commission's mapping. No ALR percentage split is stated.

Market thinness, labelled correctly: SnapStats has NO land category (Detached vs "Condos & Townhomes" combined; Maple Ridge community detached median $1,131,000 and attached median $525,000 that month) — no detached or attached figure is presented as a land figure. Maple Ridge IS a SnapStats-covered community; figures are community/sub-area context only.

blocks.text: Bare-land strata

items.t: Form, stated plainly: a bare-land strata lot IS strata tenure — the buyer owns a strata lot, pays strata fees, is bound by the strata bylaws, and diligence runs through the Form B, exactly as with any strata; what differs is that the lot itself is bare land / a detached-house lot rather than a unit in a shared building envelope.

What is verified here: No named bare-land strata development, strata plan number, lot count, or fee/bylaw detail for any East Central bare-land strata was verified on an official, developer or strata source in the research — all UNCONFIRMED. Do not quote a plan number, a lot count or a fee for a bare-land strata lot here until the title and Form B are pulled.

These are policy designations over largely built parcels — any assembly is a private negotiation over built lots, not a listed vacant-land offering.

items.t: The City publishes no boundary for the MLS "East Central" sub-area; the Town Centre Area Plan covers the downtown core at the west side of the sub-area, and its boundaries were expanded in the plan update to incorporate River Bend; the wider sub-area takes in the residential streets east and north of downtown toward 232 Street and 124 Avenue.

Schools physically inside the sub-area: Golden Ears Elementary (K–7), 23124 118 Avenue; Harry Hooge Elementary (K–7), 12280 230 Street; Thomas Haney Secondary (7–12), 23000 116 Avenue; ci:tməxw Environmental Community (K–8), 23125 116 Avenue; District 42 Alternative Secondary (9–12), 23125 116 Avenue. Catchments are address-based in SD42, which has no middle tier (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12) — for the downtown sample address 11897 227 Street, the district locator gives Eric Langton Elementary and Thomas Haney Secondary, with French Immersion options at Maple Ridge Elementary (early), Eric Langton Elementary (late) and Maple Ridge Secondary; catchments for other addresses are not confirmed.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in East Central

items.t: Lougheed Transit Corridor — ADOPTED Jan 27, 2026: Official Community Plan Amending Bylaw No. 7781-2021 was given third reading and adopted at the Jan 27, 2026 council meeting (public hearing Jan 20, 2026; City news release Feb 4, 2026); the corridor runs from the City's western boundary to the Town Centre at 221 Street along Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road. Cite it as adopted. An earlier contrary reading of this plan's status exists in program material — any page or note still calling it proposed is stale.

Albion Area Plan: adopted Oct 28, 2025 as part of the City's fall 2025 OCP/area-plan update series (Town Centre, Hammond, Silver Valley and Albion) — Albion is east of this sub-area, but the same update series is the planning context for East Central's Town Centre changes.

SSMUH / suites / subdivision potential as the City states it: one secondary suite per lot inside the single detached building, maximum 40% of gross floor area, not within the floodplain area; eligible single-family and duplex lots may have up to three, four or six units under the City's SSMUH bylaws. Subdivision of an RS-1 lot must still meet the s. 605 minimums (668.0 m² / 18.0 m / 27.0 m) — SSMUH unit counts do not create new fee-simple lots by themselves.

Bare-land strata rules (where a bare-land strata lot is bought — the BC strata block applies in full to the lot): Form B diligence (fees, amounts owed, levies, CRF balance, insurance summary; provided within 7 days, max $35 + 25¢/page); depreciation reports on a 5-year cycle for stratas with 5+ lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022 (short-term restrictions may still apply by bylaw); only 55+ age bylaws valid under SPA ss.123.1/123.2, with May 1, 2023 exemptions (younger spouse/partner, caregivers, legacy residents, defined children); a listing's "45+" line is NOT a valid BC age bylaw.

ALR rules (for completeness — no ALR ground was identified here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR.
Maple Ridge property taxes: 2026 taxes were due July 2, 2026; a 5% penalty applies to any outstanding balance on July 3, 2026 and an additional 5% on September 2, 2026.

blocks.text: Good to know about East Central

items.t: East Central's land story is density policy, not vacant lots (2026): the Town Centre Core designation, the two Transit-Oriented Areas (Haney Place Exchange and Port Haney Station, Bylaw No. 8001-2024), the adopted Lougheed Transit Corridor (Bylaw No. 7781-2021, adopted Jan 27, 2026) and the Albion Area Plan adoption (Oct 28, 2025) in the same fall 2025 update series all push value into assemblies and added units on built lots — a buyer pricing a teardown on today's single-house use alone misses the documented policy direction, and a buyer pricing it as if rezoning were assured overpays for a designation, not an approval.

Civic cluster on the land a buyer is actually walking: Maple Ridge Leisure Centre, 11925 Haney Place; Memorial Peace Park on 224 Street between Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road (City Hall, the ACT Arts Centre and Haney Place Mall around it, with the Cenotaph, the Bandstand and the Haney Farmers Market); Maple Ridge Public Library, 130–22470 Dewdney Trunk Road, the only FVRL branch in Maple Ridge; Ridge Meadows Urgent and Primary Care Centre inside Haney Place Mall, 121–11900 Haney Place, open 7 days a week, 9:00 a.m.–8:00 p.m.
Hospital: Ridge Meadows Hospital, 11666 Laity Street, is the community hospital for Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows with 24/7 emergency care, west of this sub-area.

Heritage at the southwest corner: Port Haney was historically the steamboat landing and CPR station for the area, and the Bandstand in Memorial Peace Park was presented by the Maple Ridge Concert Band as a gift to the people of Maple Ridge — the oldest land in this sub-area carries heritage context a teardown buyer should check before assuming a clean rebuild.

faq.q: Which schools are in East Central?
faq.a: Golden Ears Elementary and Harry Hooge Elementary (K–7), Thomas Haney Secondary (7–12), ci:tməxw Environmental Community (K–8) and District 42 Alternative Secondary are physically in the area; catchments are address-specific — for the downtown sample address used in the research (11897 227 Street), the SD42 locator gives Eric Langton Elementary and Thomas Haney Secondary.

faq.q: How do I get downtown or to the SkyTrain?
faq.a: Port Haney Station (22300 River Road) runs West Coast Express trains to Waterfront Station on weekdays, and the R3 RapidBus runs from Haney Place Exchange to Coquitlam Central Station.

faq.q: Is flood risk a factor in East Central?
faq.a: Along the Fraser River at the south edge (River Road / Port Haney), yes: the flood construction level is 6.7 m geodetic, no habitable floor space may sit below it on affected lots, and floodplain status is registered by covenant on title.

faq.q: What changed in the Town Centre plan?
faq.a: The Town Centre Area Plan update expanded the plan boundaries to include River Bend, consolidated the land use designations, and added a Town Centre Core designation for higher densities around the Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station.

faq.q: Can I buy a bare building lot in East Central?
faq.a: There is no lot product to buy — no named bare-land subdivision, named bare-land strata plan or presale lot offering exists here.

faq.q: What is the smallest lot I can create by subdividing an RS-1 property?
faq.a: The RS-1 minimums are 668.0 m² area, 18.0 m width and 27.0 m depth (Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 s.

faq.q: What does "bare-land strata" mean on a detached-house listing here?
faq.a: You own a strata lot, pay strata fees, follow the bylaws and diligence through the Form B — but the lot is a detached-house lot, not a unit in a shared building.

faq.q: Can an older house lot carry more units without subdividing?
faq.a: Yes, on the City's wording: one secondary suite per lot (maximum 40% of gross floor area, not in the floodplain) plus up to three, four or six units on eligible single-family and duplex lots under the SSMUH bylaws. Eligibility is lot-specific — confirm with the City.

faq.q: Does the floodplain affect a south-edge lot?
faq.a: Yes — flood construction level 6.7 m geodetic, no habitable floor space below it on affected lots, a covenant on title, and suites prohibited on floodplain properties under s. 402.8(h). Confirm the covenant and level on title before valuing any lower-level space.

faq.q: Is there vacant land to buy in East Central?
faq.a: Effectively no as a standing market — the research verifies no bare-land subdivision and no presale lot offering; what trades is built house lots, strata units, and occasional redevelopment assemblies. A "lot" listing here is almost always a teardown or hold lot, not a serviced vacant lot.

faq.a: The RS-1 minimums are 668.0 m² area, 18.0 m width and 27.0 m depth (Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019 s.

faq.q: What does "bare-land strata" mean if I see it on a detached-house listing here?
faq.a: You own a strata lot, pay strata fees, follow the bylaws and get a Form B — but the lot is a detached-house lot, not a unit in a shared building.
